about: Helium (He) is an inert gas that is much lighter than air. It is used to fill advertising and event balloons, as a shielding gas for TIG welding of some metals, for leak detection, and as a carrier gas in laboratory instruments such as gas chromatographs.
Tell us the number and size of balloons you plan to fill and we can help you choose the right cylinder. Helium displaces oxygen, so never inhale it from balloons or cylinders.
